referents.why: 'them' is the object of the piling: the dead frogs of Exo.8.9. The frogs are not among this verse's candidates, and none of the offered candidates is the frogs

the doer of the piling (masculine plural 'they') is unnamed, most likely the Egyptians gathering the dead; no candidate is a masculine plural people, and the nearest, houses and fields, are places, not doers

links.why: the land stank after the piling (cl0), not before; the link runs backward
wayyiqtol: they piled them, and then the land stank, on the narrative line
